sentences.text: And for this act of kindness the petitioners as in duty bound shall ever pray."

3. Mr. Mohanty, learned counsel for the Petitioners submits that due to the fact that the land in question has been recorded in the name of deity Sri ShreeRam Mandir, bije- Routarapur, marfat Krupasindhu Samanta, hence, the land acquisition compensation has been deposited with learned Commissioner of Endowments, Odisha, Bhubaneswar.

4. In course of hearing, Mr. Mohanty, learned counsel for the Petitioners submits that a revision under Section 15(b) of the Orissa Survey and Settlement Act, 1958 for correction of the RoR, has already been filed which is pending before the Additional Commissioner, Land records and settlement, Orissa Cuttack-1, Jajpur for adjudication.
Hence, he prays for withdrawal of the writ petition to pursue the remedy before the revisional Authority.
5. Mr. Biswal, learned Additional Standing Counsel does not have any objection to the same.
6. In view of such submission, the writ petition is disposed of as withdrawn.
7. The Petitioners are at liberty to pursue that remedy before the revisional Authority.

(K.R. Mohapatra)
 Judge  (Savitri Ratho)
